name: fizzl-paypal-guard-mcp
description: PayPal's Agent Toolkit with limits on refunds and your Approve or Deny above them.
long_description: The same 47 tools as PayPal's own MCP server, with fizzl-paypal-guard in front of every call that moves or promises money. Reads pass straight through. A refund is never more than is left of the payment and stays within your limits (by default $25 per refund, $100 and 10 refunds a day, one per payment a day). Above them, and for every accepted dispute, price change or invoice marked as paid, you approve or deny: on your phone through the Fizzl Agent Wallet or your own Telegram bot, or in a form in Claude itself. No answer means no. The day's counts and a log of every decision stay on your computer. Start with a sandbox REST app from developer.paypal.com: test money only.
